beacon.source: number: Etherscan getblocknobytime (closest=after, timestamp=T); hash and timestamp: eth_getBlockByNumber on ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, also Blockscout get_block_info; parent 26396628 has timestamp 1794459599 < T; finalized before use (finalized head 26396650)

doc: The seal of I106's fresh sealed targets (HUMAN_ANSWERS Q54 (c)). target_sha256 is sha256 of the exact bytes of target.json, which stays in the sealer's session until the reveal; salt_sha256 is sha256 of the 32 salt bytes, equal to the prereg key's (spec/M6/predictions/I106.json thresholds.seal). The beacon is the first Ethereum mainnet block whose timestamp is >= T_unix. spec/M6/lib/I106_draw.py verify recomputes the seed, the draw and both hashes after the reveal.
